description: Everything known about one Sydney venue: its menus and dishes with allergen status per dish, venue-wide allergen notes (dedicated fryer, shared prep), how many dishes are free of each allergen, diner ratings for coeliac and allergy friendliness, opening state, address, booking and map links, and the pages the menus were read from with dates. Use the id or slug returned by search_dishes or list_allergen_free.

id.description: Venue id from a search result.

slug.description: Venue slug from a search result, e.g. 'pinocchio-cremorne', or its page URL.
